reason: We already have a plan to go into a new country and one or two fairs a year won't fill that pipeline, so I need something like this. EUR 1,500 up front with the rest tied to five real meetings is a small bet next to one bad fair stand, and the free list of 15 companies lets me check them before I sign anything.
objection: Do they actually understand industrial buyers in our niche? A logistics company getting 45 meetings tells me nothing about whether they can reach the right procurement or technical person at a manufacturer abroad. I also worry that cold outreach done badly will hurt our name in a market where we are new and reputation is everything.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are generic or wrong for our niche, or the first message reads like spam in the local language, I walk away. Talking to a past client in a manufacturing or export niche close to ours would settle it the other way.
